note: Small Butler County Conservation park in Greene on the west bank of the Shell Rock River below the dam: electric sites along a gravel lane by the river, an open shelter and a canoe ramp. City pool across the street; shops in walking distance. Pack in, pack out. --Claude
summary: mycountyparks: 10 electric sites (20/30/50 A), new shower house 2024, dump, water; $20 first-come, $25 reservable (sites 5-6 only, +$4 fee, 1 yr window, 7 days ahead, 2-night weekend min online); May 1-Oct 15 with off-season self-registration; 14-night max. Phone found: Butler CCB office 319-346-6551. Waterfront lead up.
flags: PHONE: none stored. Suggest 319-346-6551 (Butler County Conservation Board office, given on the site pages for cancellations: 'call the Butler CCB office at 319-346-6551 Monday through Friday 7:00 AM - 3:30 PM'; same number on the county's mycountyparks page). WEBSITE OK.

WATERFRONT LEAD (up): not waterfront -> riverview proposed. Stored evidence says the bank is 'lined with trees'; imagery shows the park's gravel lane running along the west bank of the Shell Rock (~85-100 m wide here, riverfront scale), ending in a turnaround, with a 15-25 m strip of open grass and riprap between the lane and the water along its northern half and trees on the bank further south (Esri and NAIP, 0.24 m/px). An RV on Esri sits at the lane's river-side edge, but I could not see pads or electric posts to tell which side the ten sites are on. If they are on the town side, the lane blocks on-water and a view across it is the most it supports; if some sit on the river side of the lane with open grass to the bank, riverfront would need checking. Unsure, so riverview.
PIN: stored 42.89210,-92.80113 is in the grass south of the turnaround, ~90 m from the middle of the lane (~42.8926,-92.8019). Under 250 m, so OK; refine to ~42.8926,-92.8019 if convenient.
